data.name: 1. Set up the group and notifications
2. Choose who can be on call
Enter a keyword to search, or select a role to immediately view all employees in that role.
data.value: 输入关键词进行搜索，或选择一个角色以立即查看该角色下的所有员工。

data.name: Enter a name/account to search, or select a role to automatically paginate and list all employees in that role. Paging does not clear selected members. The member order below represents the rotation order.
data.value: 输入姓名/账号进行搜索，或选择一个角色以自动分页列出该角色的所有员工。翻页不会清除已选成员。下方成员的顺序即为轮换顺序。

data.name: Enter in UTC; it will not be automatically converted based on team time zones. Once a shift is saved, the scheduling start point cannot be changed.
data.value: 请以 UTC 时间输入；系统不会根据团队时区自动转换。保存排班后，排班起始时间将无法更改。

data.name: Members can be added or removed at any time; removing a member only clears scheduled shifts that have not started, while started and historical shifts are retained. Any resulting vacant shifts must be manually staffed.
data.value: 成员可随时添加或移除；移除成员仅会清除尚未开始的排班，已开始和历史排班将予以保留。由此产生的空缺班次必须手动安排人员。

data.name: Multiple teams can share the same template. Switching or modifying the template will not regenerate saved shifts.
data.value: 多个团队可以共用同一个模板。切换或修改模板不会重新生成已保存的轮班安排。

data.name: No members selected. Find people above and tick their names to add them.
data.value: 尚未选择成员。请在上方查找人员并勾选其姓名以添加。

data.name: On-call emails are automatically sent to the user mailboxes (To) of all On-Call Engineers (OCEs) in the currently saved shift. CC only uses team mailboxes or mailing list addresses explicitly configured here; it does not automatically CC all team members. Supports line breaks, commas, or semicolons as separators, up to 50 addresses; leave blank to omit CC. Custom push channels configured in the application will still deliver additional notifications.
data.value: 当前已保存班次中所有值班工程师（OCE）的用户邮箱都会自动收到值班邮件（收件人）。抄送仅使用在此处明确配置的团队邮箱或邮件列表地址，不会自动抄送所有团队成员。地址之间可用换行、逗号或分号分隔，最多支持 50 个地址；留空则不抄送。应用中配置的自定义推送渠道仍会发送额外通知。

data.name: Save this group first, then open its schedule to assign people to shifts. Only saved shifts determine who receives on-call emails.
data.value: 请先保存此组，然后打开其排班表以将人员分配至班次。只有已保存的班次才能确定谁将收到值班邮件。

data.name: Saving this form updates the group and its member list. It does not generate or publish a schedule. Removing a member clears their future assignments; review the schedule for gaps.
data.value: 保存此表单将更新该组及其成员列表。此操作不会生成或发布排班表。移除成员将清除其未来的排班分配；请检查排班表是否有空缺。

data.name: Scheduling options: rule template and UTC start point
data.value: 排班选项：规则模板和 UTC 起始时间点

data.name: Search by name or account, or browse a role. Tick individual people to add them. Selecting a role only filters the search; membership is not synchronized with that role.
data.value: 按姓名或账号搜索，或按角色浏览。勾选要添加的人员。选择角色仅用于筛选搜索结果；成员不会与该角色同步。

data.name: Search by timezone name, city, or UTC offset. Schedule anchors are stored in UTC and displayed using the team's timezone.
data.value: 可按时区名称、城市或 UTC 偏移量搜索。排班锚点以 UTC 存储，并按团队时区显示。

data.name: Selected members (can be empty, max 200)
data.value: 已选成员（可为空，最多 200 人）

data.name: Selected members in rotation order (maximum 200)
data.value: 已选成员（按轮换顺序，最多 200 人）

data.name: These are the people available for scheduling. Joining this list does not put someone on duty or send them an incident email.
data.value: 这些是可参与排班的人员。加入此列表并不会使某人进入值班状态，也不会向其发送事件邮件。

data.name: To: the people assigned to the saved shift when the incident occurred. The original recipients and CC addresses are retained for later incident emails. Use commas, semicolons or new lines; up to 50 CC addresses.
data.value: 收件人：事故发生时已分配到已保存班次的人员。后续事故邮件将保留原收件人和抄送地址。请使用逗号、分号或换行分隔，最多可填写 50 个抄送地址。

data.name: Use Move up and Move down to choose the order used for future automatic scheduling. Existing shifts are not reordered.
data.value: 使用“上移”和“下移”来选择未来自动排班的顺序。现有的班次不会重新排序。

data.name: Used to display the schedule. The advanced scheduling start point below is entered separately in UTC.
data.value: 用于显示排班。下方的高级排班起始时间需单独以 UTC 输入。
